proof_body:
by
  intro E _ _ f a v p hx hp
  have hc : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => a + t • v) 0 := by fun_prop
  have hx' : IsLocalExtr f (a + (0 : ℝ) • v) := by simpa using hx
  have h2 := IsLocalExtr.comp_continuous (g := fun t : ℝ => a + t • v) (b := 0) hx' hc
  exact h2.hasDerivAt_eq_zero hp
target_source: ∀ (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : E → ℝ) (a v : E) (p : ℝ), IsLocalExtr f a → HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (a + t • v)) p 0 → p = 0
